item.description: The Hong Kong Heritage Museum is reviving its tribute to the late singer-actor Leslie Cheung Kwok-wing three years after its first staging, marking the Cantopop icon’s 70th birthday with rare private collections, stage costumes and a recreated room from his former residence. Presented by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department, the “Miss You Much. Leslie 70th Birthday. Exhibition” runs from September 9 to May 10, 2027, at the museum in Sha Tin. Admission is free. item.title: ‘I suggested maybe a lighter touch’: William Shatner on Star Trek at 60
item.description: The actor and others involved with the phenomenon speak about the legacy and progressivism of a much-loved science fiction TV series as it reaches an important milestone ‘The mystery of time,” muses William Shatner , and for a moment we are back on the bridge of the Starship Enterprise listening to one of Captain Kirk’s philosophical tag-line speeches. “Not just the passage of time and our perception of it, but what is time? item.title: The Castle by Jon Ronson review – bizarre tales of modern masculinity
item.description: A journalist embarks on a wild goose chase that might – or might not – be informative about the male condition Recovering from surgery at home in upstate New York in 2023, Jon Ronson awoke to a string of texts from his adult son about a weird evening he just had at a stranger’s castle in Connecticut.
